translations.web: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.
translations.bsb: Although I trained and strengthened their arms, they plot evil against Me.
translations.kjv: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief
translations.asv: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet do they devise mischief against me.
